name: Champions Group Agent
description: Company data provider. Knows the Champions data cards and VAF fields, matches them to a buyer's need and returns aggregate insights. Never exports records or personal data over A2A.

skills.name: Describe capabilities
skills.description: Lists every data card with its VAF fields, coverage and refresh.

skills.name: Find data cards
skills.description: Ranks data cards and VAF fields for a described need and segment.
examples: Mid-size healthcare companies in Europe switching HR platforms

skills.name: Get insights
skills.description: Card matches plus aggregate insights and a small sample for a segment (needs insights:read).
examples: How many fintechs in the UK are researching payroll?

skills.name: Submit feedback
skills.description: Rate which insights from an earlier answer were useful (champions.feedback/v1: query_id + insight ratings, no reasons).
